ruleset.name: narrative-java
ruleset.description: The structural checks of narrative-java. Each rule name is its NAR code, which javachecks.py reads from the PMD report. Built-in PMD rules keep their names, and PMD_CODES in javachecks.py gives each one a NAR code.

rule.name: NAR101
rule.message: method above its first caller in this class. Order methods by first call
rule.description: P02: caller before callee. A method that this class calls goes below its first caller.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: NAR102
rule.message: two or more null arguments. Use a builder or a parameter record
rule.description: P03: a call with a null for each skipped argument.

rule.name: NAR103
rule.message: stream inside a stream lambda. Write a loop
rule.description: P06: one level of filter and map in a stream.

rule.name: NAR104
rule.message: fully-qualified name in code. Import the type
rule.description: P08: no fully-qualified name outside the imports.

rule.name: NAR105
rule.message: ordinal() written to NBT, a packet or JSON. Write name() or an explicit code field
rule.description: P17: ordinal() is not a serialised form of an enum.

rule.name: NAR106
rule.message: abstract class. Use an interface, or extend only a class the platform requires
rule.description: P18: composition over inheritance. A sealed abstract class is allowed: its permitted subclasses share its fields.

rule.name: NAR107
rule.message: default arm in a switch over an enum or sealed type. List every constant, so a missing one is a compile error
rule.description: P19: exhaustive dispatch with no fallback arm. verify.py replaces the comment SEALED_TYPES with one typeIs test per sealed type of the project.

rule.name: NAR108
rule.message: array component in a record. equals() and hashCode() compare arrays by identity. Use a List
rule.description: P22: no array component in a record.

rule.name: NAR109
rule.message: exception class name. The name of an exception class ends in Exception, and no class extends Error
rule.description: P23: the name of an exception class ends in Exception.

rule.name: NAR110
rule.message: mutable static field. Write the reason in a comment, or make it an instance field of the object with the same lifetime
rule.description: P27: a mutable static field needs a reason. javachecks.py drops the finding when a comment is above the field or after it on the same line.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //FieldDeclaration[@Static = true()] [not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final') or VariableDeclarator/ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = ('Instance', 'SidedProxy')])] [not(pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger'))] [not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1][ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'Config'] or matches(@SimpleName, 'Config(uration)?$')])]

rule.name: NAR111
rule.message: log message built with + or format(). Use a stable event name and placeholder parameters
rule.description: P28: one stable event name plus parameters.

rule.name: NAR112
rule.message: + in user-facing text. Put %s placeholders in the lang entry, and pass the values to the localization call

rule.name: NAR113
rule.message: literal user-facing text. Put it in the lang file and read it through a localization call
rule.description: S15: every user-facing string is a lang file key.

rule.name: NAR114
rule.message: allocation or stream in a draw or render method. Reuse a buffer, or cache with a dirty flag
rule.description: S03 and P06: nothing allocated per frame.

rule.name: NAR115
rule.message: java.io.File operation. It returns false or null on failure. Use the Files method on a Path

rule.name: NAR116
rule.message: method with more than 3 parameters or more than 20 body lines and no javadoc
rule.description: P34: the javadoc threshold. javachecks.py drops the finding when a javadoc is above the method, and then checks its @throws lines (NAR117).

rule.name: NAR122
rule.message: type with more than 4 names below the outermost. Name it: a record, or a functional interface for a callable
rule.description: NAR005 in Java: an annotation you cannot say out loud needs a name.

rule.name: NAR123
rule.message: && inside || without parentheses. Parenthesise each group
rule.description: NAR007 in Java: mixed && and || parenthesise each group.

rule.name: NAR124
rule.message: package-private member. Make it private or public
rule.description: A02: private or public only. Test sources are not analysed.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //(MethodDeclaration | FieldDeclaration | ConstructorDeclaration | ClassDeclaration | RecordDeclaration | EnumDeclaration) [@Visibility = 'package'] [not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[@Interface = true()])] [not(self::ConstructorDeclaration and parent::EnumBody)] [not(parent::EnumBody/parent::EnumDeclaration and self::ConstructorDeclaration)]
